cohort: 1000 antenatal women attending the outpatient department of Murshidabad medical college and Hospital, Berhampore, West Bengal, India
finding: The study found a high prevalence of thyroid disorder (11.3%), with hypothyroidism (10.8%) being more common than hyperthyroidism (0.5%).
birth_weight: LBW babies were observed as an outcome in those with hypothyroidism.
